(2) GET /api/pharmacy/telemetry/timeline?hours=168 returns {timeline:[{hour,valid,anomaly,valid_units,anomaly_units}], window_hours:168} with buckets sorted ascending. ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='camera-scanner-stop'] when the scanner never successfully started (e.g. no camera / permission denied — the exact headless case the requirement mentioned) raises an UNHANDLED runtime error 'Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused.' from html5-qrcode. The React DevServer error overlay then blocks the entire page until dismissed. The Stop handler should try/catch (or check scanner.getState() === RUNNING/PAUSED) before calling scanner.stop(). Reproduce: open Stock Intake → click Start Scan (permission denied silently) → click Stop → red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay appears.

action_items: Guard CameraScanner Stop handler with try/catch or state check so a stop-without-start does not raise an uncaught error (blocks page in dev overlay).
(Carry-over from iter-2, not addressed) Pharmacy /logout button no-op and /patient header auth-pill leak when JWT cookie present.

Consider making the call fully background (asyncio.create_task) so a slow Emergent proxy never adds 15s latency to intake response — currently the await inside stock_intake sits inline.

rca_of_the_issue.camera_stop_uncaught: html5-qrcode throws 'Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused.' whenever .stop() is invoked outside the RUNNING/PAUSED FSM state. CameraScanner.jsx invokes scanner.stop() unconditionally in the Stop button handler; when the user clicks Start but camera permission is denied (or headless / no camera), the scanner is never marked RUNNING, so the subsequent Stop click bubbles an uncaught promise rejection into React's error overlay. Fix: wrap in try/catch or check scanner.getState() === Html5QrcodeScannerState.SCANNING before calling stop().
